text:
elaine (pm): Quick design review — noticed a few docs-to-console consistency + a11y nits in the Models in-product docs panel. Short list: terminology mismatch, missing cross-links to canonical docs, focus trap when panel opens, link contrast and microcopy. Thoughts?

samir (design): :eyes: saw this during QA. Two big things: we use 'Flavor' in several overlays but docs use 'model variant'. Also panel title is just 'Docs' which is too generic when multiple doc panels exist.

maria (docs): Agree — canonical term in the docs is 'model variant'. We should align console copy. I can add anchors on the docs page (e.g., /docs/console/models#model-variants) and a short in-doc blurb. Would like a clear in-panel cross-link to that anchor.

jack (eng-ui): Implementation notes: adding a link is straightforward. The bigger issue is keyboard focus — when the panel opens focus remains on the background page, which breaks keyboard users. Proposed pattern: set `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, and move focus to a meaningful element inside the panel like the panel header. Example: `<div role="dialog" aria-label="Model docs" tabindex="-1">` then `panelEl.focus()` + focus trap.

maria (docs): Also microcopy: some places say 'route' and others say 'endpoint' — which do we prefer in the console? In docs we mostly say 'endpoint' for API examples, but console-facing copy should probably be 'route' if it's a UI route.

elaine (pm): Good call. Proposal: use 'route' in UI contexts and 'endpoint' when we mean API. @maria can you update the style guide blurb so designers/engineers have a reference?

jack (eng-ui): Another quick CSS/accessibility nit: the link color on the panel is 3:1 contrast at 14px; doesn't meet WCAG AA. Recommend changing to a darker blue and adding a visible focus ring: `:focus { outline: 3px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; }`. Also ensure the small 'open in docs' icon has `aria-label` and is keyboard focusable.

maria (docs): I'll add the terminology note to the style guide and create the `/docs/console/models#model-variants` anchor. For the in-panel link text we should use: 'Read more about model variants' — clear and action-oriented. I'll draft copy and post it here for review.

devex-bot: docs updated — /docs/console/models#model-variants (automated link).

jack (eng-ui): I'll open a PR for: focus trap, dialog attributes, add the 'Read more about model variants' link (targeting the anchor), and update the link color + focus styles. ETA: EOD.

elaine (pm): Awesome. Two last tiny asks: 1) add an automated tooltip for the link that reads 'Opens docs in a new tab' and uses `aria-describedby` (so screen readers announce it), 2) add a brief note in the release notes and request a quick UX pass once the PR is up. :sparkles:

maria (docs): Will confirm the copy here when PR is ready. I'll also add a short note in the style guide about 'route' vs 'endpoint' to avoid future drift.

samir (design): Quick follow-up on visuals: let's ensure the docs panel header includes a small breadcrumb-like label 'Models • Model variants' so users know context when they land directly in the panel. Also prefer visible separators over faint borders for low-vision users.

elaine (pm): Perfect. Thanks everyone — looks like clear action items. @jack ping us when the PR is up and @maria will confirm the final copy.

jack (eng-ui): Will do.

(ends)
